fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on hurricane risk and public preparedness; discussion of prospects for winter horse racing and betting at Hialeah; criticism of city plans and financing for a convention hall/auditorium; coverage of public health concerns focused on food inspection and sandwich production; notes on Miami Beach hospital plans; community and church-related dispute coverage; entertainment and nightlife listings and gossip columns; and sports promotion including boxing and other events in Greater Miami.
